findings.description: Response.__init__ now reads self.raw.reason, but self.raw is initialized to None in Response.__init__ and set later by the adapter. A bare Response() raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: constructing Response() directly, as tests and mocks commonly do, or any code path that creates a Response before raw is attached. Mechanism: self.raw is None at that point, so None.reason raises AttributeError. Impact: crash on construction. Also, in the normal adapter flow, build_response sets response.reason after construction, so the line is either redundant or wrong. The annotation change to str is also inaccurate, since reason can still be None.
